apps.message:
ci(pages): name the job that builds and checks the site `site`

## Intent

Every site repo should give the job that builds and checks its site the same name as tooling does: `site`. `check` stays the name of the code check.

## Key changes

- Only the job name changes: check becomes site, and deploy needs site; steps, pinned site actions and npm scripts stay.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same rename in apps (202a5e9), lernapps.github.io (4aa9c64) and docs (a79ea59); the tooling README follows (3e067bf).
- A branch protection rule or ruleset that requires the status check check must require site instead.

tooling.message:
docs(plan): step 1 done; the site job is `site` in the README

## Intent

Every site repo should give the job that builds and checks its site the same name as tooling does: `site`. `check` stays the name of the code check.

## Key changes

- The plan moves step 1 to Completed, with what changed in review: npm run check builds nothing, the docs site has its own job site, the site actions take check-script.
- The README names the site repos' jobs site, deploy and preview; the example pages.yml uses site.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same rename in apps (202a5e9), lernapps.github.io (4aa9c64) and docs (a79ea59); the tooling README follows (3e067bf).
